而蓄之者鋭則軍伍無不足矣以如是之
兵有如是之食而又得人焉以爲之用以
戰則勝以守則固何夷狄之足患哉此固
執事未發之意而狂瞽無已之誠也不識
執事以爲何如
punctuated: 衆而用之者舒，則倉廪無不充矣。繕器械之利，勸簡閱之法，明賞罰之格，養之者厚，而蓄之者鋭，則軍伍無不足矣。以如是之兵，有如是之食，而又得人焉以爲之用，以戰則勝，以守則固，何夷狄之足患哉！此固執事未發之意，而狂瞽無已之誠也。不識執事以爲何如？
translation_en: …are many, while those who consume it do so sparingly, then every granary will be full. Put weapons and equipment into good working order, promote procedures for mustering and inspecting the troops, and clarify the rules for rewards and punishments. If the troops are generously provisioned and those maintained in readiness are keen, the ranks will be fully supplied. With troops such as these and provisions such as these, and with capable men secured to employ them, we will win in battle and hold firm in defense. What cause would there be to fear the peoples beyond our borders? This is surely the intention that you, honored examiners, have left unexpressed; it is also the unceasing sincerity of this rash and benighted candidate. I wonder what you think of it?

title: 嘉靖二十八年陝西鄉試錄
text:
陝西鄉試錄後序
嘉靖己酉陝西鄉試錄成 全
當序諸末簡謹敘曰上古羲
皇毓秀成紀繼天立極仰觀
俯察則河圖以畫卦泄天元
之秘開聖學之源大哉萬世
之文祖也是故有伏羲而後
===
有神農黃帝堯舜禹湯文武
周公孔子傳道之統有易卦
而後有詩書禮樂春秋載道
之文易畫於伏羲辭繫於文
王周公書載二帝三王之治
而文武成康周召呂畢之政
詳矣詩首二南正以二雅王
punctuated:
陝西鄉試錄後序

嘉靖己酉陝西鄉試錄成，全當序諸末簡，謹敘曰：上古羲皇毓秀成紀，繼天立極，仰觀俯察，則河圖以畫卦，泄天元之秘，開聖學之源。大哉，萬世之文祖也！是故有伏羲而後有神農、黃帝、堯、舜、禹、湯、文、武、周公、孔子傳道之統；有易卦而後有詩、書、禮、樂、春秋載道之文。易畫於伏羲，辭繫於文王、周公；書載二帝三王之治，而文、武、成、康、周、召、呂、畢之政詳矣。詩首二南，正以二雅，王
translation_en:
Postface to the Record of the Shaanxi Provincial Examination

The Record of the Shaanxi Provincial Examination for the jiyou year of Jiajing [1549] having been completed, I, Quan, am charged with writing a postface on its final pages. I respectfully set forth the following:

In high antiquity, the sovereign Fuxi, nurtured in excellence at Chengji, succeeded Heaven and established the supreme standard. Observing above and examining below, he took the River Chart as his model in drawing the trigrams, revealing the secrets of Heaven’s primal origin and opening the wellspring of sagely learning. How great he was—the progenitor of culture for all ages! Thus, only after Fuxi came the lineage transmitting the Way through Shennong, the Yellow Emperor, Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Kings Wen and Wu, the Duke of Zhou, and Confucius. Only after the hexagrams of the Changes came the writings that carry the Way: the Poetry, Documents, Rites, Music, and Spring and Autumn Annals.

The figures of the Changes were drawn by Fuxi, and their statements were appended by King Wen and the Duke of Zhou. The Documents records the rule of the Two Emperors and Three Kings, giving detailed accounts of the governance of Kings Wen, Wu, Cheng, and Kang, and of Zhou, Shao, Lü, and Bi. The Poetry begins with the Two Nan sections and is given its proper standard by the Two Ya sections; the royal …

title: 嘉靖二十八年陝西鄉試錄
text:
迹基于豳風成于周頌美哉
泱泱乎舉周之德也禮樂至
周大備春秋自魯史之法孔
子脩之夫非憲章文武繼述
周公者耶是可以觀雍之人
文矣謂不有本於雍之地之
靈乎洪惟我
===
皇上崇文中命紹道統之淵微著
心學之奥旨海内文學弟子
訢訢嚮風矧全陝肇闢人文
之地漸被尤著丕應益宏有
不振揚奮厲彬彬濟濟超越
菁莪棫樸之化者乎迺得其
文而校閱之見其雄深而典
punctuated:
迹基于豳風，成于周頌。美哉，泱泱乎，舉周之德也！禮樂至周大備，春秋自魯史之法，孔子脩之，夫非憲章文武、繼述周公者耶？是可以觀雍之人文矣，謂不有本於雍之地之靈乎？
洪惟我皇上崇文中命，紹道統之淵微，著心學之奥旨。海内文學弟子訢訢嚮風，矧全陝肇闢人文之地，漸被尤著，丕應益宏，有不振揚奮厲，彬彬濟濟，超越菁莪棫樸之化者乎？迺得其文而校閱之，見其雄深而典
translation_en:
…the traces of royal achievement have their foundation in the Airs of Bin and reach their fulfillment in the Hymns of Zhou. How beautiful, how magnificent: they encompass the virtue of Zhou! Rites and music attained their full development under Zhou. The Spring and Autumn Annals followed the conventions of Lu’s historical records, which Confucius revised. Was this not taking Kings Wen and Wu as models and carrying forward the work of the Duke of Zhou? Here one may discern the literary culture of Yong. Could one say that it was not rooted in the numinous potency of Yong’s land?
We reverently consider how our Emperor promotes literary culture [the wording 崇文中命 is doubtful], carries forward the profound subtleties of the transmission of the Way, and elucidates the abstruse purport of the learning of the mind. Students of letters throughout the realm joyfully turn toward his influence. How much more so in all of Shaanxi, the land where literary culture first emerged: here his transforming influence is especially evident, and the response grows ever greater. Could its scholars fail to rouse themselves and strive vigorously, accomplished and numerous, surpassing even the transformative cultivation celebrated in Luxuriant Southernwood (Jing e) and Oak and Thorn (Yu pu)? When I obtained their compositions and examined them, I found them powerful, profound, and classically…

title: 嘉靖二十八年陝西鄉試錄
text:
則渾厚而廣遠敷腴而冲贍
雖具體人人殊要之閎中肆
外發揮六經之旨曲暢旁通
各極其趣沈浸醲郁燦如也
迺於其文之潔靜精微而徵
易教焉於其文之疏通知遠
而徵書教焉於其文之溫柔
===
敦厚而徵詩教焉於其文之
屬辭比事而徵春秋教焉於
其文之恭儉莊敬廣博易良
而徵禮樂之教焉猗歟休哉
其周之舊乎斯其爲國楨歟
斯其爲地之靈人之傑歟猶
未也今日之所以徵諸士者
punctuated: 則，渾厚而廣遠，敷腴而冲贍。雖具體人人殊，要之閎中肆外，發揮六經之旨，曲暢旁通，各極其趣，沈浸醲郁，燦如也。迺於其文之潔靜精微而徵《易》教焉，於其文之疏通知遠而徵《書》教焉，於其文之溫柔敦厚而徵《詩》教焉，於其文之屬辭比事而徵《春秋》教焉，於其文之恭儉莊敬、廣博易良而徵禮樂之教焉。猗歟休哉！其周之舊乎？斯其爲國楨歟？斯其爲地之靈、人之傑歟？猶未也。今日之所以徵諸士者
translation_en:
… and well ordered, substantial and far-reaching, abundant and richly composed. Although their particular forms differ from writer to writer, in essence they are capacious within and expansive in expression. They elucidate the purport of the Six Classics, fully develop its subtleties and interconnections, and pursue each meaning to its utmost. Deeply steeped in this rich learning, they shine brilliantly.
In the purity, tranquility, precision, and subtlety of their writing, we discern the teaching of the Book of Changes; in its comprehensive understanding and knowledge of the distant past, the teaching of the Book of Documents; in its gentleness and generosity, the teaching of the Book of Odes; in its arrangement of words and juxtaposition of events, the teaching of the Spring and Autumn Annals; and in its reverence, frugality, dignity, and respectfulness, its breadth, ease, and goodness, the teachings of rites and music. Ah, how splendid! Is this the ancient tradition of Zhou? Are these men to be pillars of the state? Are they the spiritual excellence of this land and the outstanding talents among its people? Yet this is not all. That by which these scholars are assessed today…

title: 嘉靖二十八年陝西鄉試錄
text:
文也由是而之焉明經以致
用不緣經以媢世步趨往哲
靡易前脩及其至可以希周
召呂畢之勳充其養可以成
楊張蘇呂之學以無負掄擇
之公仰稱登庸之典則信乎
爲國之楨而主司亦得以與
===
榮矣雍之人文不亦末有譽
哉尚相與勗諸
四川重慶府巴縣儒學敎諭
盧奎謹序
punctuated:
文也。由是而之焉，明經以致用，不緣經以媢世；步趨往哲，靡易前脩。及其至，可以希周、召、呂、畢之勳；充其養，可以成楊、張、蘇、呂之學。以無負掄擇之公，仰稱登庸之典，則信乎爲國之楨，而主司亦得以與榮矣。雍之人文，不亦末有譽哉？尚相與勗諸！
四川重慶府巴縣儒學敎諭盧奎謹序。
translation_en:
…is their literary compositions. Proceeding from this, they should illuminate the Classics in order to put them into practice, rather than use the Classics as a pretext for resenting the world [?]; they should follow the sages of the past without departing from their worthy predecessors. At their highest attainment, they may aspire to achievements like those of Zhou, Shao, Lü, and Bi; by fully developing their cultivation, they may attain learning like that of Yang, Zhang, Su, and Lü. Thus they will not disappoint the impartial selection made here and will worthily fulfill the purpose of the institution that advances men to office. Then they will indeed be pillars of the state, and the officials presiding over the examination may share in their glory. Will not the cultural accomplishments of Yong also win renown [?]? Let us encourage one another in this endeavor!
Respectfully prefaced by Lu Kui, Instructor of the Confucian School of Ba County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan.
